mapper.select: SELECT mber_id AS mber_id , password AS password , mber_nm AS mber_nm , email AS email , mber_gbn AS mber_gbn , unique_id FROM tb_mber WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND mber_id = #{mberId};

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1 AS `rownum` , `unique_id` AS `unique_id` , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_mber A
WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR mber_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
WHERE mber_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
) AS `total_cnt` , `mber_id` AS `mber_id` , `mber_nm` AS `mber_nm` , `email` AS `email` , `use_yn` AS `use_yn` , (SELECT cd_nm FROM tb_code where csf_cd = 'POSITION' AND cd = `position`) AS `position` , DATE_FORMAT(`creat_dttm`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS `creat_dttm` , (SELECT inqire_dt FROM tb_systemlog slog where slog.unique_id = unique_id limit 0,1) AS `last_login_at` FROM tb_mber , (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) AS TEMP
WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR mber_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
WHERE mber_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY `creat_dttm` DESC ) A WHERE A.ROWNUM BETWEEN (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1)) - (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) - 1) AND (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1))

SELECT `mber_id` AS `mber_id` , `mber_nm` AS `mber_nm` , `unique_id` AS `unique_id` , `use_yn` AS `use_yn` , `mber_gbn` AS `mber_gbn` , `password` AS `password` , `email` AS `email` , `position` AS `position` , `creat_dttm` AS `creat_dttm` , ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`inqire_dt`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') FROM tb_systemlog WHERE `unique_id` = `unique_id` ORDER BY `inqire_dt` DESC LIMIT 1) AS `last_login_at` FROM tb_mber WHERE unique_id = #{unique_id}

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT @ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1 AS `rownum` , DATE_FORMAT(`inqire_dt`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS `inqire_dt` , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_systemlog WHERE unique_id = #{unique_id}) AS `total_cnt` , srvc_nm AS `srvc_nm` , inqire_info AS `inqire_info` , rqester_ip AS `rqester_ip` FROM tb_systemlog , (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) AS TEMP WHERE unique_id = #{unique_id} ORDER BY inqire_dt DESC ) A WHERE A.ROWNUM BETWEEN (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1)) - (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) - 1) AND (IFNULL(#{limit}, 10) * IFNULL(#{page}, 1))
SELECT csf_cd AS csf_cd , cd AS cd , cd_nm AS cd_nm , cd_dsc AS cd_dsc FROM tb_code WHERE csf_cd IN ('POSITION','ROLE')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS emailCheck FROM tb_mber WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS idcheck FROM tb_mber WHERE mber_id = #{mber_id}
